contract: An initial authenticated presentation retains one shell and exact release while acquisition fails or waits. Retry is generation-scoped and single-flight. It cancels and drains prior work, closing cancellation-resistant late leases before starting another attempt. Owner cancellation rejects further retries and drains resources. Successful acquisition transfers exactly one live lease; retired attempts never mount. Native mounting and first-frame recovery follow the separate nativeRecovery contract below.

nativeRecovery.contract: Initial native mount failure and sustained first-frame wait retain the same logical presentation and artifact lease. Retry retires and drains the previous native host before resetting unseen lifecycle/input state and mounting a new generation. Stale frames/failures cannot affect its replacement; durable admission and shown occur once. Close remains terminal and drains all attached owners. Outgoing navigation recovery is separate.
